title: Gateway EML-2 orbital mechanics and stationkeeping audit
question: Audit the exact OTA-TEC-0087 draft using NASA, JPL and peer-reviewed cislunar-dynamics sources. Determine: (1) the correct physical relationship between Earth-Moon L2, halo orbits and near-rectilinear halo orbits; (2) whether describing a future Gateway as operating 'at EML-2' can reasonably denote an L2-associated halo/NRHO region without conflating the mathematical point with the orbit; (3) representative stationkeeping delta-v and stability characteristics for relevant NRHO/halo families; (4) illumination/eclipse properties relevant to solar power; (5) Earth visibility and lunar-polar access claims; and (6) wording/reclassification needed in OTA-TEC-0087. Distinguish [R] demonstrated/established, [H] technically plausible extrapolation, [F] fictional setting and [OFFEN] insufficiently resolved. Do not alter fictional station capacity, dock-slot count, depot capacity or NOXIA balancing.
why_now: Gateway is still ENTWURF because its EML-2/NRHO interpretation must be evidence-closed before activation.
real_world_anchor: Earth-Moon L2 libration dynamics, halo/NRHO orbit families, stationkeeping, illumination and cislunar Gateway mission design.
novelty_reason: First source-pinned audit of Gateway's L2/NRHO interpretation.
validation_summary: Der Kandidat ist ein interner Anker- und Terminologie-Audit zu OTA-TEC-0087-2026-DE (Gateway-Station EML-2). Er bestätigt alle [R]-Anker des Dossiers (L2-Punktgeometrie und kollineare Instabilität, Halo-/NRHO-Familienzugehörigkeit, Stationhaltungs-Delta-v, Finsternis-/Beleuchtungsbilanz, Erd-Sichtbarkeit, Südpol-Dwell, cislunare Strahlung) und liefert belastbare Realzahlen, die im Dossier bislang als [OFFEN] bzw. [H] geführt werden. Kein Kanonwert wird in Frage gestellt: die fiktionalen Infrastrukturwerte (8 Dock-Slots, 500 t Depot, CYGNUS-Flugzahl) bleiben unberührt und werden ausdrücklich nicht validiert.
